template_name: 好的感谢您的确认以下是为您量身定制的沉稳
description:
用户需求: 好的，感谢您的确认。以下是为您量身定制的**沉稳自然科普PPT模板完整方案**，所有细节已基于您的偏好和常见需求完成设计。

---

### 一、整体风格定位
- **主题**：沉稳自然 · 森林科普  
- **核心氛围**：静谧、厚重、有生命力，仿佛漫步在晨雾弥漫的古老森林中，每一页都像一本自然史书的插页。
- **适用场景**：自然科普课件、生态调研报告、环保主题演讲、动植物图鉴展示等。

---

### 二、配色方案
| 角色 | 色值（HEX） | 象征 |
|------|-------------|------|
| 主色（深森林绿） | `#2C5F2D` | 树木、稳定、深沉 |
| 辅助色（苔藓绿） | `#6B8E23` | 草地、生机、过渡 |
| 背景色（米灰） | `#F5F0E8` | 羊皮纸质感、柔和阅读 |
| 强调色（琥珀棕） | `#8B5E3C` | 树干、年轮、大地 |
| 点缀色（珍珠白） | `#FEFEFE` | 露珠、文字高亮 |
| 深色文字 | `#1E2A1E` | 可读性、与背景协调 |

---

### 三、字体选择
- **标题**：`思源宋体`（粗体）—— 沉稳、有学术感，笔画略带书卷气  
- **正文**：`思源黑体`（常规）—— 清晰、无衬线，适合长时间阅读  
- **装饰数字/章节标号**：`Adobe Caslon Pro` 或 `游明朝体`（斜体）—— 模仿年轮上的刻字效果  
- **手写点缀**（仅少量引言或关键词）：`方正清刻本悦` 或 `Bradley Hand` 柔版

---

### 四、版式结构与页数设计（共6种内页）

1. **封面（1页）**  
   - 背景：全幅山脉轮廓剪影（深绿色渐变，下方浅）
   - 中央：白色标题（大号思源宋体），下方一行小字副标题
   - 底部：分散排列的动物剪影（鹿、猫头鹰、松鼠）和几颗露珠（珍珠白小圆点）
   - 左上角置入一个半透明的年轮纹理作为装饰

2. **目录页（1页）**  
   - 两栏布局，左栏宽度占1/3，右栏占2/3
   - 左栏：从上到下放置4个年轮纹理圆圈，圆圈内各写数字（如01-04）
   - 右栏：对应目录文字，每行左端用一个小动物剪影图标作为引号
   - 背景：淡淡的苔藓绿纹理（类似青苔）

3. **章节过渡页（每章1页）**  
   - 整页背景：占据页面60%面积的动物剪影（如鹿、鹰）居中，剪影颜色为深森林绿+半透明
   - 章节标题用琥珀棕色大字写在剪影下方
   - 左上角或右下角点缀一滴露珠（小渐变圆）和一行“Chapter 01”数字

4. **正文页-图文混排版（主用）**  
   - 左图右文：图片占左半页（矩形，圆角8px），顶部覆盖一条露珠装饰线（3~4个半透明露珠）
   - 右文：标题用思源宋体，正文用思源黑体，行距1.5，左侧加一条深绿色竖线（模拟树枝）
   - 底部：可加一排小山脉轮廓作为页脚分隔线
   - 背景：米灰底色，四周留白充足

5. **正文页-满版插图版**  
   - 整张大图（如森林实景或动物特写）做背景
   - 在图片中央或下方放置一个半透明琥珀棕色色块（60%透明），色块内放标题和正文文字（白色）
   - 色块形状：可以是不规则自然形状（如椭圆或手撕纸边），增加手作感
   - 角落可加一个年轮纹理小标（表示“重点”）

6. **引用/重点页 / 结束页**  
   - 背景：放大后的年轮纹理（极淡，作为底纹）
   - 中央：一段引用文字或总结金句（用琥珀棕色，字体可加粗）
   - 下方：山脉轮廓横线，线下方写“THANK YOU”或网站名称
   - 最后一页：全页露珠散落（极淡）+ 中央“END”字样

---

### 五、装饰元素应用规范
- **动物剪影**：统一使用黑色/深绿色，简化线条（非写实），作为图标或背景轮廓。每个场景不超过3个。
- **年轮**：作为数字标号、章节分隔、边框装饰，颜色为琥珀棕，不重叠文字区域。
- **露珠**：珍珠白色小圆形，带一点点透明渐变（从上到下变透明），用于点缀图片区、标题旁，增加水润感。
- **山脉轮廓**：水平方向延展，作为页脚分隔线或背景层次，颜色为深绿色叠加透明度40%。

---

### 六、建议的演示软件设置
- 页面比例：16:9（标准宽屏）
- 参考分辨率：1920×1080
- 字体嵌入：确保所有字体下载并嵌入PPT中

---

### 七、设计提示（给制作者）
- 请确保所有剪影和纹理是矢量图或高分辨率PNG（300dpi），避免放大模糊。
- 露珠使用圆形渐变（从高亮到透明），可用PPT形状格式轻松制作。
- 山脉轮廓可重复使用，但每次调整透明度或位置避免单调。
- 保持每个页面的视觉留白 >30%，符合“沉稳”气质。

---

以上就是完整的设计方案，您可以直接拿给设计师或PPT制作者使用。请问您是否满意？或者需要对其中某个页面的布局再做微调？

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>森林生态系统 · 自然科普PPT</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@400;500;700&family=Noto+Serif+SC:wght@600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
    <style>
        /* ===== 全局重置 & 基础 ===== */
        *,
        *::before,
        *::after {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --color-background: #F5F0E8;
            --color-text: #1E2A1E;
            --color-text-muted: #5A6B5A;
            --color-primary: #2C5F2D;
            --color-secondary: #6B8E23;
            --color-accent: #8B5E3C;
            --color-card: #F0EBE0;
            --color-surface: #E8E2D5;
            --font-body: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Source Han Sans SC', sans-serif;
            --font-heading: 'Noto Serif SC', 'Source Han Serif SC', serif;
        }

        html,
        body {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            color: var(--color-text);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        /* ===== 幻灯片容器 ===== */
        .slides-wrapper {
            position: relative;
            width: 1280px;
            height: 720px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            overflow: hidden;
            background: var(--color-background);
        }

        .slides-track {
            display: flex;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            will-change: transform;
        }

        /* ===== 单页 ===== */
        .slide {
            position: relative;
            width: 1280px;
            height: 720px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: var(--color-background);
        }

        /* ===== 公共组件 ===== */
        .page-title {
            position: absolute;
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 32px;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }

        .page-content {
            position: absolute;
            top: 130px;
            left: 60px;
            right: 60px;
            bottom: 60px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 400;
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 1.7;
            color: var(--color-text);
        }

        .slide-footer {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 20px;
            right: 60px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .page-num {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--color-accent);
            background: rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.10);
            padding: 2px 14px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.18);
        }

        /* ===== 导航 ===== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 32px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            display: flex;
            gap: 14px;
            z-index: 20;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(44, 95, 45, 0.25);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
            outline: none;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--color-primary);
            transform: scale(1.25);
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(44, 95, 45, 0.35);
        }

        .nav-arrows {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 0 18px;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 25;
        }

        .nav-arrow {
            pointer-events: auto;
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.70);
            backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 20px;
            cursor: pointer;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10);
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
            user-select: none;
            border: 1px solid rgba(44, 95, 45, 0.10);
        }

        .nav-arrow:hover {
            background: var(--color-primary);
            color: #fff;
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        .page-indicator {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 24px;
            left: 60px;
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            z-index: 20;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
        }

        .page-indicator .current {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            font-size: 19px;
        }

        /* ============================================================
                   各页面专属样式
                   ============================================================ */

        /* ---------- 封面 ---------- */
        .slide.cover {
            background: linear-gradient(170deg, #F5F0E8 0%, #e8e0d0 100%);
        }

        .cover .cover-title {
            position: absolute;
            top: 110px;
            left: 80px;
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 58px;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            line-height: 1.2;
            max-width: 680px;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(44, 95, 45, 0.06);
        }

        .cover .cover-subtitle {
            position: absolute;
            top: 260px;
            left: 84px;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 400;
            font-size: 22px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 6px;
        }

        .cover .date-badge {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 90px;
            left: 80px;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 500;
            font-size: 16px;
            color: var(--color-accent);
            background: rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.08);
            padding: 8px 24px;
            border-radius: 40px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.15);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }

        /* 封面山脉 */
        .cover-mountains {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 140px;
            opacity: 0.30;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .cover-mountains svg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }

        /* 封面动物剪影 */
        .cover-animals {
            position: absolute;
            right: 70px;
            top: 180px;
            font-size: 72px;
            opacity: 0.20;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            line-height: 1.2;
            text-align: right;
            pointer-events: none;
            letter-spacing: 18px;
        }

        /* 年轮装饰 */
        .cover-ring {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50px;
            right: 70px;
            width: 110px;
            height: 110px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 3px solid rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.18);
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 45% 45%, transparent 50%, rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.06) 80%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .cover-ring::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 18px;
            left: 18px;
            right: 18px;
            bottom: 18px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.12);
        }

        .cover-ring::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 38px;
            left: 38px;
            right: 38px;
            bottom: 38px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.08);
        }

        /* 露珠 */
        .dewdrop {
            position: absolute;
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.80) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10) 80%);
            pointer-events: none;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
        }

        .dewdrop-sm {
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
        }

        .dewdrop-lg {
            width: 26px;
            height: 26px;
        }

        /* ---------- 目录 ---------- */
        .slide.toc {
            background: var(--color-background);
        }

        .toc .page-title {
            top: 50px;
            left: 70px;
            font-size: 38px;
        }

        .toc .page-title::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -8px;
            left: 0;
            width: 70px;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--color-accent);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .toc .page-content {
            top: 140px;
            left: 70px;
            right: 70px;
            bottom: 80px;
            display: block;
            overflow: visible;
        }

        .toc-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 28px;
            padding: 0;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .toc-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 24px;
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--color-text);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(44, 95, 45, 0.06);
            padding-bottom: 16px;
            transition: color 0.2s;
            cursor: default;
        }

        .toc-item:hover {
            color: var(--color-primary);
        }

        .toc-num {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 52px;
            height: 52px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.25);
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 22px;
            color: var(--color-accent);
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, transparent 55%, rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.05));
            flex-shrink: 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        .toc-num::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 6px;
            left: 6px;
            right: 6px;
            bottom: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 1px dashed rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.10);
        }

        .toc-icon {
            font-size: 28px;
            opacity: 0.35;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            margin-left: auto;
            transition: opacity 0.2s;
        }

        .toc-item:hover .toc-icon {
            opacity: 0.65;
        }

        .toc-text {
            flex: 1;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* 目录页装饰 - 苔藓纹理 */
        .toc-moss {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            right: 0;
            width: 280px;
            height: 100%;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 50%, rgba(107, 142, 35, 0.04) 0%, transparent 70%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ---------- 章节过渡 ---------- */
        .slide.section {
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, #F5F0E8 0%, #ece4d6 100%);
        }

        .section .page-title {
            top: 90px;
            left: 80px;
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--color-accent);
            letter-spacing: 6px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.06);
            padding: 4px 18px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.10);
        }

        .section .section-title {
            position: absolute;
            top: 200px;
            left: 80px;
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 54px;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            line-height: 1.2;
            max-width: 650px;
        }

        .section .subtitle {
            position: absolute;
            top: 320px;
            left: 84px;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 400;
            font-size: 22px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            max-width: 550px;
            border-left: 3px solid var(--color-secondary);
            padding-left: 20px;
        }

        /* 章节页动物剪影 */
        .section-animal {
            position: absolute;
            right: 40px;
            top: 100px;
            font-size: 220px;
            opacity: 0.10;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            pointer-events: none;
            line-height: 1;
            user-select: none;
        }

        /* 章节页露珠 */
        .section .dewdrop {
            top: 140px;
            right: 310px;
        }

        .section .dewdrop-sm {
            top: 200px;
            right: 280px;
        }

        /* ---------- 内容页 ---------- */
        .slide.content {
            background: var(--color-background);
        }

        .content .page-title {
            top: 45px;
            left: 70px;
            font-size: 34px;
        }

        .content .page-title::before {
            content: '🌲';
            font-size: 28px;
            margin-right: 14px;
            opacity: 0.50;
        }

        .content .page-content {
            top: 120px;
            left: 70px;
            right: 70px;
            bottom: 80px;
            
            
            
            
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 26px;
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            
            min-height: 0;
        }

        .content .page-content::before {
            content: '📄 此处放置内容';
            opacity: 0.30;
            font-weight: 300;
            font-size: 22px;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
        }

        /* 内容页装饰 - 左侧树枝竖线 */
        .content-branch {
            position: absolute;
            top: 60px;
            left: 40px;
            width: 3px;
            height: 280px;
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--color-primary), transparent);
            opacity: 0.20;
            border-radius: 4px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .content-branch::after {
            content: '🌿';
            position: absolute;
            top: -6px;
            left: -12px;
            font-size: 22px;
            opacity: 0.50;
        }

        /* 内容页露珠装饰线 */
        .content-dewdrops {
            position: absolute;
            top: 32px;
            left: 200px;
            display: flex;
            gap: 18px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .content-dewdrops .dewdrop {
            position: static;
            display: inline-block;
        }

        /* 内容页山脉脚线 */
        .content-mountains {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 58px;
            left: 70px;
            right: 70px;
            height: 28px;
            opacity: 0.15;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .content-mountains svg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }

        /* ---------- 结尾页 ---------- */
        .slide.ending {
            background: linear-gradient(165deg, #F5F0E8 0%, #e6ddd0 100%);
        }

        .ending .ending-content {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 680px;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .ending .ending-content h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 58px;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            letter-spacing: 6px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(44, 95, 45, 0.06);
        }

        .ending .ending-message {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 400;
            font-size: 22px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            border-top: 2px solid rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.12);
            padding-top: 28px;
            display: inline-block;
        }

        /* 结尾年轮底纹 */
        .ending-ring-bg {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            width: 520px;
            height: 520px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.06);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .ending-ring-bg::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 40px;
            left: 40px;
            right: 40px;
            bottom: 40px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.05);
        }

        .ending-ring-bg::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 80px;
            left: 80px;
            right: 80px;
            bottom: 80px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid rgba(139, 94, 60, 0.04);
        }

        /* 结尾露珠散落 */
        .ending-dewdrops {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .ending-dewdrops .dewdrop {
            opacity: 0.15;
        }

        /* ===== 响应式缩放 ===== */
        @media (max-width: 1320px) {
            .slides-wrapper {
                transform: scale(0.85);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 1100px) {
            .slides-wrapper {
                transform: scale(0.72);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .slides-wrapper {
                transform: scale(0.58);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .slides-wrapper {
                transform: scale(0.44);
            }
        }

        /* ===== 滚动条美化 ===== */
        .page-content::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 4px;
        }
        .page-content::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: transparent;
        }
        .page-content::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--color-primary);
            border-radius: 10px;
            opacity: 0.3;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <div class="slides-wrapper" id="slidesWrapper">
        <div class="slides-track" id="slidesTrack">

            <!-- ===================== SLIDE 1: 封面 ===================== -->
            <div class="slide cover">
                <!-- 封面山脉背景 -->
                <div class="cover-mountains">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 1280 140" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMax meet">
                        <path d="M0,140 L60,90 L120,110 L190,60 L250,85 L310,40 L370,70 L430,30 L490,55 L550,10 L610,35 L670,5 L730,30 L790,15 L850,45 L910,20 L970,50 L1030,25 L1090,60 L1150,40 L1210,80 L1280,55 L1280,140 Z"
                        fill="#2C5F2D" opacity="0.35" />
                        <path d="M0,140 L80,100 L150,120 L220,80 L290,100 L360,60 L440,85 L510,50 L580,75 L650,40 L720,65 L790,35 L860,60 L930,30 L1000,55 L1070,25 L1140,50 L1210,30 L1280,60 L1280,140 Z"
                        fill="#2C5F2D" opacity="0.18" />
                    </svg>
                </div>

                <!-- 年轮装饰 -->
                <div class="cover-ring"></div>

                <!-- 动物剪影 -->
                <div class="cover-animals">🦌 🦉</div>

                <!-- 露珠 -->
                <div class="dewdrop" style="top:100px;left:280px;"></div>
                <div class="dewdrop dewdrop-sm" style="top:76px;left:340px;"></div>
                <div class="dewdrop dewdrop-sm" style="top:520px;left:220px;"></div>
                <div class="dewdrop dewdrop-lg" style="top:480px;left:640px;"></div>

                <!-- 标题 -->
                <h1 class="cover-title">森林生态系统</h1>
                <p class="cover-subtitle">一场关于自然与生命的对话</p>

                <!-- 日期徽章 -->
                <div class="date-badge">2024 · 自然科普</div>

                <!-- 页脚 -->
                <div class="slide-footer">
                    <span class="page-num">01</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- ===================== SLIDE 2: 目录 ===================== -->
            <div class="slide toc">
                <div class="page-title">目录</div>

                <div class="page-content">
                    <ul class="toc-list">
                        <li class="toc-item">
                            <span class="toc-num">01</span>
                            <span class="toc-text">森林的层次 · 从树冠到地底</span>
                            <span class="toc-icon">🌳</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="toc-item">
                            <span class="toc-num">02</span>
                            <span class="toc-text">植物与光合作用 · 生命的引擎</span>
                            <span class="toc-icon">🌿</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="toc-item">
                            <span class="toc-num">03</span>
                            <span class="toc-text">动物的栖息地 · 共生与竞争</span>
                            <span class="toc-icon">🦉</span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="toc-item">
                            <span class="toc-num">04</span>
                            <span class="toc-text">生态系统的平衡 · 脆弱与坚韧</span>
                            <span class="toc-icon">🌍</span>
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <!-- 苔藓装饰 -->
                <div class="toc-moss"></div>

                <!-- 露珠 -->
                <div class="dewdrop dewdrop-sm" style="top:80px;right:120px;"></div>
                <div class="dewdrop" style="top:600px;right:200px;"></div>

                <!-- 页脚 -->
                <div class="slide-footer">
                    <span class="page-num">02</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- ===================== SLIDE 3: 章节过渡 ===================== -->
            <div class="slide section">
                <div class="page-title">第一章</div>

                <h1 class="section-title">森林的层次</h1>

                <p class="subtitle">从树冠到地底的生命交响</p>

                <!-- 动物剪影 -->
                <div class="section-animal">🦌</div>

                <!-- 露珠 -->
                <div class="dewdrop" style="top:140px;right:310px;"></div>
                <div class="dewdrop dewdrop-sm" style="top:200px;right:280px;"></div>
                <div class="dewdrop dewdrop-sm" style="top:560px;left:220px;"></div>

                <!-- 页脚 -->
                <div class="slide-footer">
                    <span class="page-num">03</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- ===================== SLIDE 4: 内容页 ===================== -->
            <div class="slide content">
                <div class="page-title">森林的垂直结构</div>

                <!-- 装饰元素在 page-content 外部 -->
                <div class="content-branch"></div>

                <div class="content-dewdrops">
                    <span class="dewdrop"></span>
                    <span class="dewdrop dewdrop-sm"></span>
                    <span class="dewdrop"></span>
                    <span class="dewdrop dewdrop-sm"></span>
                </div>

                <!-- 内容占位区（完全空白，仅保留占位符） -->
                <div class="page-content">{{content}}</div>

                <!-- 山脉脚线 -->
                <div class="content-mountains">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 1140 28" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMax meet">
                        <path d="M0,28 L40,10 L90,16 L140,6 L190,12 L240,4 L290,10 L340,2 L390,8 L440,3 L490,9 L540,2 L590,7 L640,3 L690,9 L740,4 L790,10 L840,5 L890,11 L940,6 L990,13 L1040,8 L1090,15 L1140,10 L1140,28 Z"
                        fill="#2C5F2D" opacity="0.40" />
                    </svg>

                    <span class="page-num">04</span>

            </div>

            <!-- ===================== SLIDE 5: 结尾 ===================== -->
            <div class="slide ending">
                <!-- 年轮底纹 -->
                <div class="ending-ring-bg"></div>

                <!-- 露珠散落 -->
                <div class="ending-dewdrops">
                    <span class="dewdrop dewdrop-sm" style="top:60px;left:120px;"></span>
                    <span class="dewdrop" style="top:180px;right:160px;"></span>
                    <span class="dewdrop dewdrop-sm" style="bottom:140px;left:260px;"></span>

                    <span class="dewdrop dewdrop-sm" style="top:380px;left:80px;"></span>

        </div>
        <!-- /slides-track -->

        <!-- 导航点（由JS动态生成） -->
        <div class="nav-dots" id="navDots"></div>

        <!-- 导航箭头 -->
        <div class="nav-arrows">
            <div class="nav-arrow" id="prevBtn" onclick="prevSlide()">◀</div>
            <div class="nav-arrow" id="nextBtn" onclick="nextSlide()">▶</div>
        </div>

        <!-- 页码指示器 -->
        <div class="page-indicator">
            <span class="current" id="currentPage">1</span>
            <span> / </span>
            <span id="totalPages">5</span>
        </div>

    </div>
    <!-- /slides-wrapper -->

    <script>
        (function() {
            const track = document.getElementById('slidesTrack');
            const slides = track.querySelectorAll('.slide');
            const totalSlides = slides.length;
            let currentIndex = 0;

            // ---- 更新页面指示器 ----
            const currentSpan = document.getElementById('currentPage');
            const totalSpan = document.getElementById('totalPages');
            if (totalSpan) totalSpan.textContent = totalSlides;

            // ---- 动态生成导航点 ----
            const navDots = document.getElementById('navDots');
            navDots.innerHTML = ''; // 清空（确保没有硬编码）
            for (let i = 0; i < totalSlides; i++) {
                const dot = document.createElement('div');
                dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                dot.onclick = (function(idx) {
                    return function() { goToSlide(idx); };
                })(i);
                navDots.appendChild(dot);
            }
            const dots = navDots.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');

            // ---- 切换核心 ----
            function goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0) index = 0;
                if (index >= totalSlides) index = totalSlides - 1;
                currentIndex = index;
                // 滑动
                track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (-currentIndex * 1280) + 'px)';
                // 更新导航点
                dots.forEach(function(d, i) {
                    d.classList.toggle('active', i === currentIndex);
                });
                // 更新页码
                if (currentSpan) currentSpan.textContent = currentIndex + 1;
            }

            // ---- 暴露全局 ----
            window.goToSlide = goToSlide;

            window.prevSlide = function() {
                goToSlide(currentIndex - 1);
            };

            window.nextSlide = function() {
                goToSlide(currentIndex + 1);
            };

            // ---- 键盘支持 ----
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    window.prevSlide();
                } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    window.nextSlide();
                }
            });

            // ---- 初始化 ----
            goToSlide(0);

            // 暴露当前索引用于箭头边界禁用（可选）
            // 但 goToSlide 已经做了 clamp
        })();
    </script>

</body>
</html>
